description: Every automation on this brand in ONE list, whatever runs it: Meta, Google Ads and TikTok ad rules, boost automations (boost the best organic posts), alert channels (events pushed to Slack, Discord or a webhook), comment-to-DM automations and the autopilot post refill. Each row: id (use it with get_automation, set_automation_status, update_automation, delete_automation, automation_runs, test_automation), type, account, on or off, whether it can change ad spend, a one-line summary. Says when the team switch has every ad automation off. An engine that could not be read is named, never shown as empty. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account to read rules on, when the brand shares several

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser to read rules on, when the brand shares several

status.description: only those switched on, or off

name: list_automations
title: List every automation
